mainEntity.name: How often does electrical equipment need to be tested and tagged?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the environment. Under AS/NZS 3760, factories, workshops, and warehouses need testing every 6 months. Construction sites require testing every 3 months. Offices and retail spaces are tested annually.
